About.title: About
About.p1: I’m Ilyas Benyahia, a front-end developer and UI/UX designer based in Rabat / Témara, Morocco. My path started in business management, continued through graphic design and digital communication, and now extends into a master’s degree in strategic marketing.
About.p2: I have a dual profile: the web, where I design and build interfaces with React and Next.js, and video games, where I create indie games such as Colors Recipe.
About.p3: My ambition: building profitable digital products, from the idea all the way to growth. That is what leads me towards the Growth Engineer role.
